# Zetapro

> Zetapro is a free mental math trainer. It has a Zetamac-style speed game (Classic), stats that show which problem types slow you down, drills built from your slow and missed problems, 80 in 8 (80 multiple-choice questions in 8 minutes), and probability and quant reasoning games for trading interview prep. It runs in the browser, installs as an offline phone app, and has a Windows app. No ads, no analytics, sign-in optional.

Key facts:

- Classic mode uses Zetamac's default settings: addition of numbers from 2 to 100, multiplication of 2–12 by 2–100, subtraction and division as their reverses, 120 seconds, answers accepted the moment they're right.
- Every answer is timed and sorted by type (carries, borrows, each times table, two-digit products). Missed problems come back the next day, then 3 and 7 days later.
- The probability and quant reasoning games cover probability and expected value, number sequences, ranking likelihoods, estimation intervals (scored lower ÷ upper), order-book arbitrage, and short speed, attention and risk games. Each has an untimed Learn mode that explains every answer and a timed Test mode.
- Zetapro is independent and not affiliated with Zetamac or any trading firm.

- [Zetamac alternative](https://zetapro.app/zetamac-alternative/): what Zetapro keeps from Zetamac and what it adds
